name: Ministry of Education, Government of India
role: Nodal ministry for Kashi Tamil Sangamam. Approves the programme, releases funds and coordinates the participating institutions.

name: Central Institute of Classical Tamil, Chennai
role: Implementing institute for KTS 5.0: runs this portal, the student registration and selection, the 21-language orientation, the digital repository and all Thirukkural content.

name: Indian Institute of Technology Madras
role: Nodal institute for Kashi Tamil Sangamam on the Tamil Nadu side; delegate logistics and the Tamil Nadu programme.

name: Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi
role: Coordinating institute in Kashi; academic sessions, the Kashi programme and co-host of the National Conference on the Thirukkural.

name: Bharatiya Bhasha Samiti
role: Partner for the Annual National Conference on the Thirukkural and for the multilingual translation network.

name: Central Institute of Indian Languages, Mysuru
role: Support for translations, dubbing and subtitling of the orientation lectures into the scheduled languages.

name: University Grants Commission
role: Circulates the call for applications to universities and colleges across India and nominates faculty mentors.

name: All India Council for Technical Education
role: Outreach to technical institutions for student registration.

name: Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation
role: Travel, accommodation and local tours for delegates; Thirukkural displays at railway stations with Indian Railways.

name: Airports Authority of India
role: Thirukkural couplet displays on passenger information systems and signage at airports.

name: National Highways Authority of India
role: Thirukkural couplet displays at highway toll plazas.

name: Ministry of Culture, Government of India
role: Cultural troupes, screenings of the Thirukkural short films and cultural showcases at KTS venues.

name: Central Board of Secondary Education
role: Daily Kural initiative in schools, comic books, posters and storytelling workshops.

name: Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan and Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti
role: Daily Kural morning-assembly calendar and distribution of printed charts to schools.

name: Government of Tamil Nadu
role: State-level coordination, Tamil Development Department and host colleges in Tamil Nadu.

name: Government of Uttar Pradesh and Varanasi District Administration
role: Venue, security and local arrangements in Kashi.
